name: Chiloeches (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Chiloeches (a white house and three bees on green).
history: Chiloeches adopted its arms and flag officially on 1 February 2002; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, divided vertically into three equal parts, green at the hoist and the fly and white in the centre bearing the crowned municipal arms.

features.role: Chiloeches arms — white house and three bees on green
